scientific_integrity: All-length proof by exact cone-join and nullhomotopic graph attaching map; finite computation independently checks faces and mod-two homology for 2 through 10. The bipartite base formula is prior background, not a new result.
scientific_limitations: Uniform formula only for triangular books with all vertex degree caps equal to two. No equivariant statement or independent mathematical validation. Possible unindexed equivalent literature.
title: An edge-activation wedge theorem for two-matching complexes of triangular books
